_comment: FIELD DOY-129, 61 sta GPS L1W/L2W, held-out consumer WTZZ00DEU, 12 h fresh.  Base = _fldf3_pl2_ctl_new.json (the converging leveling posture, SPEC_amb_iono s6.15.4 probe 7) with ONE knob added: network.readmit_seed_horizon_s = 3900.  Everything else, including the extends chain, is character-identical to the control, so `git diff` of this file against _fldf3_pl2_ctl_new.json is the knob plus the two run paths.

WHY THIS IS A PRE-REGISTERED NULL, NOT A FIX ATTEMPT (measured on runs/fldf3_pl2_ctl_new + runs/fldf3_pl2_rtlog, 2026-09-10).  The consumer's 665 resets in 12 h are 100 % SSR PHASE-BIAS discontinuity resets (rt_engine.log; 357 L1W + 308 L2W, zero on any other channel).  networkStashCarry parks only SharedParamKind::Clock and ::CodeBias - PhaseBias is excluded by construction (NetworkRunContext.cpp:4785-4791, 'a stiff PB seed would fight that pin'), and the ledger scope says the same ('Phase bias is NOT seeded').  So the seed cannot touch the channel that produces every reset.

TARGET POPULATION, counted before arming (standing invariant #3/#4).  (a) CODE BIAS: network.estimate_sat_code_bias is OFF on this chain - every emit line reads '0 code biases', products.txt carries zero B records, and no TOPOLOGY col_removed/col_added label is a CB.  So readmit_seed_code_bias reads true and will seed ZERO columns: armed here the card degenerates exactly to the clock-only variant the ledger records as FALSIFIED ('the T3 tails RETURN', runs/readmit24h_e2clk).  (b) CLOCK: 8 clock-column departures in 12 h (G01 G12 G14 G16 G20 G22 G25 G26), all returning inside 3900 s (690-3300 s), against 70 PB-column departures.  (c) REGIME: the ledger regime is on(clock_temporal_anchor) and not on(clock_model); clock_temporal_anchor is absent from the whole pl2 chain (loader default false), so the Q3 anchored fold never runs and the seed lands at var + q*gap with filter.process_noise.sat_clock_q = 0.001 m^2/s, i.e. sigma = sqrt(0.001*3200) = 1.79 m - a prior that cannot bind against a 61-station clock re-solve.  The sim golden's clock_anchor_q = 3e-6 gives 0.098 m, 18x tighter; that difference is the card's validated mechanism and it is not present here.

NO COMPANION KNOB IS ADDED.  Arming clock_temporal_anchor would put the card in regime but is a SECOND knob family, FINGERPRINTED and SOLVE-AFFECTING, so this run would no longer isolate readmit and would need its own pl2+Q3 control - two more 12 h arms.  Arming estimate_sat_code_bias would give the seed its CB half but is a THIRD family, fingerprinted, and its own ledger row says grade BIAS-ONLY.  Both violate 'an arm = a golden plus ONLY the knob under test'.

PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTION (recorded before the run; 2026-09-10).  P1 consumer settled rms (>= h6) 3.178 m -> 3.178 m, |delta| < 0.05 m; p50 2.418 -> 2.418.  P2 consumer resets G12 191 / G25 82 / G24 76 -> unchanged +-2 (G24 and G06 never lose a clock column at all, so they cannot be touched even in principle).  P3 the h4-h7 hourly rms block 2.352 / 3.638 / 5.091 / 4.280 m -> unchanged +-0.1 m.  P4 producer wire churn 5025 adjacent-epoch |dPB| > 0.05 m bumps / 4839 disc-counter bumps on 114 keys -> unchanged +-2 %.  P5 THE COUNTERS THAT MAKE THIS FALSIFIABLE (invariant #4 - read these, not the absence of a crash): n_readmit_parked ~ 8 and ALL of kind clock, n_readmit_seeded_clk <= 8, n_readmit_seeded_cb = 0 EXACTLY, n_readmit_expired = 0, n_readmit_dropped_datum ~ 0, and READMIT park / seed_clock / seed_held / seed_moved events on G01 G12 G14 G16 G20 G22 G25 G26 only.  If n_readmit_seeded_cb > 0 or the consumer moves by more than P1's band, the structural argument above is wrong and the reading must be redone.

WHAT THIS RUN BUYS EVEN IF THE NULL HOLDS: it converts a source-read structural argument into measured counters on the field bed, and it is the first field exercise of the READMIT park/seed path (validated only on the sim golden, runs/readmit24h_e2).  It does NOT test the re-admission hypothesis for the field consumer - that hypothesis is already falsified on the control: 3 of 665 resets (0.5 %) fall within +-10 min of a return of their own satellite, and consumer rms in the 30 min after a return is 3.176 m vs 3.287 m elsewhere.
